hierarchy: 一级大类 → 二级分组容器 → 三级叶子技能

硬件、嵌入式与底层系统.name: 硬件、嵌入式与底层系统

T1.chinese_name: 计算机硬件与数字电路设计
T1.english_definition: Knowledge of circuit boards, processors, chips, digital logic and electronic equipment; ability to carry out hardware design, hardware performance testing and hardware fault troubleshooting.
T1.chinese_definition: 掌握处理器、芯片、数字逻辑、电路原理；具备硬件设计、硬件性能测试、硬件故障排查能力

T2.chinese_name: 嵌入式系统与固件开发
T2.english_definition: Knowledge of embedded hardware architecture, firmware principles and hardware-software interface; ability to develop embedded firmware, configure embedded equipment and debug embedded terminal systems.
T2.chinese_definition: 掌握嵌入式硬件架构、固件、软硬件接口原理；具备嵌入式固件开发、设备配置、嵌入式系统调试能力

T3.chinese_name: 操作系统原理与系统运维
T3.english_definition: Knowledge of operating system scheduling, memory management, process mechanism and virtualization technology; ability to deploy, configure, maintain operating systems and virtualized environments, and resolve system runtime anomalies.
T3.chinese_definition: 掌握操作系统调度、存储、进程、虚拟化原理；具备操作系统与虚拟化环境部署、运维、运行故障处置能力

T4.chinese_name: 计算机网络与通信基础设施
T4.english_definition: Knowledge of communication transmission mechanism, network protocol, LAN/WAN topology and routing rules; ability to design network architecture, configure network devices and locate communication link faults.
T4.chinese_definition: 掌握通信传输、网络协议、路由、局域网广域网架构；具备网络拓扑设计、网络设备配置、链路故障排查能力

T5.chinese_name: 网络安全与数据隐私管控
T5.english_definition: Knowledge of vulnerability assessment, encryption technology, access control, intrusion detection and privacy compliance regulations; ability to execute security defense deployment, penetration testing and cyber emergency response.
T5.chinese_definition: 掌握漏洞评估、加密、访问控制、入侵检测、隐私合规理论；具备安全防护部署、渗透测试、网络安全应急处置能力

T6.chinese_name: 通用程序设计与软件工程
T6.english_definition: Knowledge of programming paradigms, software design specifications and application development theories; ability to write business program code, complete module design and iterative development of application software.
T6.chinese_definition: 掌握编程范式、软件设计规范、应用开发理论；具备业务代码编写、软件模块设计、应用迭代开发能力

T7.english_definition: Knowledge of classical algorithms, data structure theory and basic data analysis methods; ability to design algorithms, process structured data and solve conventional computational problems.
T7.chinese_definition: 掌握经典算法、数据结构、基础数据分析理论；具备算法设计、结构化数据处理、常规计算问题求解能力

T8.chinese_name: 机器学习与智能系统研发
T8.english_definition: Knowledge of pattern recognition, computational intelligence and machine learning fundamentals; ability to build machine learning models, develop intelligent application pipelines and evaluate model performance.
T8.chinese_definition: 掌握模式识别、计算智能、机器学习基础理论；具备模型搭建、智能应用链路开发、模型效果评估能力

T9.english_definition: Knowledge of linear algebra, probability, statistics and mathematical optimization; ability to construct mathematical models, complete data statistical analysis and optimize model parameters.
T9.chinese_definition: 掌握线性代数、概率论、统计、优化理论；具备数学建模、数据统计分析、模型参数调优能力

系统架构、工程实施与测试.name: 系统架构、工程实施与测试

T10.english_definition: Knowledge of system engineering principles and architecture design methodologies; ability to sort out business requirements, design distributed system architecture and formulate overall technical schemes.
T10.chinese_definition: 掌握系统工程原理、架构设计方法；具备需求梳理、分布式架构设计、整体技术方案制定能力

T11.english_definition: Knowledge of software release standards, cluster deployment specifications and system operation specifications; ability to deploy distributed service clusters, carry out online delivery and daily system maintenance.
T11.chinese_definition: 掌握软件发布、集群部署、系统运行规范；具备分布式集群部署、上线交付、系统日常运维能力

T12.english_definition: Knowledge of testing theory, quality control standards and performance evaluation indicators; ability to conduct functional testing, performance testing, system inspection and put forward optimization suggestions.
T12.chinese_definition: 掌握测试理论、质量规范、性能评价指标；具备功能、性能测试，系统检验并输出优化方案能力

T13.english_name: Technical Software, Cloud Platform & Development Tool Utilization
T13.chinese_name: 专业软件、云平台与开发工具应用
T13.english_definition: Understand applicable scenarios of development software, database systems, cloud infrastructure, container tools and middleware; ability to select and use mainstream technical tools to support development, analysis and operation work.
T13.chinese_definition: 掌握开发软件、数据库、云基础设施、容器、中间件适用场景；能够选用主流工具支撑开发、数据分析、运维工作

F1.english_definition: Understand the value of emerging technical knowledge for ongoing and future problem solving and decision making.

F2.english_definition: Employ logic and reasoning to compare advantages and disadvantages of different technical schemes and conclusions.

F3.chinese_name: 数理建模与问题求解能力
F3.english_definition: Apply mathematical and statistical reasoning to model and resolve practical engineering challenges.

F4.chinese_name: 自我监测与工作复盘能力
F4.english_definition: Evaluate personal work quality and project execution effect, and carry out iterative optimization.

F5.english_definition: Summarize general rules from scattered information; apply universal principles to tackle specific technical problems.

F6.english_definition: Stick to challenging technical objectives and persist when facing technical obstacles and repeated failures.

F7.chinese_name: 严谨细致与职业诚信自律
F7.english_definition: Keep rigorous in technical work; maintain ethical awareness during data processing and model development.

F8.chinese_name: 积极倾听与口头技术沟通能力
F8.english_definition: Fully absorb the viewpoints of stakeholders and accurately convey technical information orally.

F9.chinese_name: 书面技术文档撰写表达能力
F9.english_definition: Express technical logic, schemes and experimental results clearly through documents, reports and specifications.

F10.english_definition: Adjust personal work rhythm to cooperate with team members and jointly complete R&D and project delivery.

F11.chinese_name: 多方权衡与方案决策能力
F11.english_definition: Balance costs, risks and benefits of multiple technical solutions to select feasible schemes together with stakeholders.

F12.english_definition: Reconcile divergent opinions and promote stakeholders to recognize feasible technical routes.

F13.chinese_name: 时间与资源统筹管理能力
F13.english_definition: Reasonably arrange personal and team schedules, allocate manpower, computing and financial resources.

F14.chinese_name: 环境适应与压力耐受能力
F14.english_definition: Adapt to continuous technology iteration; calmly cope with high-pressure project delivery and technical emergencies.

F15.chinese_name: 需求洞察与业务服务意识
F15.english_definition: Identify implicit demands of business users and actively design matching technical solutions.
